refnamediv.refpurpose: Residue computation for partial fraction expansion and reconstruction.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [r, p, k, e] = residue(b, a) [b, a] = residue(r, p, k, e)

listitem.para: Residues of the partial fraction expansion (vector).
Poles of the partial fraction expansion (vector).
Coefficients of the direct polynomial term (vector).

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `residue` function computes the partial fraction expansion of a rational function represented by the numerator `b` and denominator `a`. It returns the residues `r`, poles `p`, and direct term coefficients `k`. The function can also reconstruct the numerator and denominator polynomials from the residues, poles, and direct term.
